claim_scope: A same-host, same-resource diagnostic of Route 1 single-point energy+force solvent overhead and a named GAFF2/OBC-II MM comparison. Every result is indexed by gas MLIP, molecule-size bin, device, OpenMM platform, and warm versus in-process construction-cold policy. It is not a universal faster-than-MM, negligible-overhead, or production-throughput claim.

case_selection.policy: Label-blind performance representatives selected by atom count, element support, availability of frozen AM1-BCC charges, and reproducible GAFF2 topology construction; experimental hydration labels were not consulted.
case_selection.topology_determinism_screen: The large-bin candidate must produce one byte-level frcmod SHA256 across 20 independent parmchk2 invocations from the exact pinned MOL2 on the recorded AmberTools installation.
case_selection.rejected_large_case: mobley_8124669 (alachlor) produced two frcmod variants and is excluded from the formal matrix.
case_selection.accepted_large_case: mobley_2078467 (ibuprofen) produced one frcmod variant in all 20 invocations.
case_selection.assembly_guard: All three model cells for a case must independently rehash to the same semantic MOL2, frcmod, prmtop, and inpcrd topology identities.

route1.charge: frozen AM1-BCC from the pinned source manifest

mm_comparator.name: GAFF2 plus OpenMM OBC-II/ACE
mm_comparator.topology_source: the same pinned GAFF-typed MOL2 and frozen AM1-BCC vector
mm_comparator.includes: GAFF2 bonded and gas nonbonded terms plus OBC-II/ACE implicit solvent

warm.definition: Persistent calculators and OpenMM contexts; each sample changes one coordinate by 1e-5 Angstrom and requests energy plus forces.

construction_cold.definition: Within an already-started Python process and with parsed structures plus prepared topology available, construct a fresh calculator or OpenMM System/Context and perform its first fully materialized energy+force evaluation. Six paired samples use an equal AB/BA order. Python process startup, imports, charge generation, parmchk2, and tleap are excluded.

limitations: Three label-free development structures are performance representatives, not an accuracy set.
The large-bin case was selected only after a label-blind topology-determinism screen; the screen is an engineering fairness gate, not scientific validation.
Construction-cold is an in-process calculator/context cold start and is not Python-process or filesystem-cache cold.

The named MM comparison changes the gas potential and measures runtime only; its Route 1 and MM calls are interleaved within a dedicated paired block, but it is not an energy or accuracy parity comparison.
Host-load isolation is checked at entry, immediately before timing, and immediately after timing; these endpoint snapshots do not prove continuous whole-run isolation.
No timing ratio may be generalized beyond the exact recorded model, molecule, device, OpenMM platform, and warm/cold definition.
The protocol does not predeclare that Route 1 will be faster than the named MM comparator.
